title: Copper handoff — Night SRE sprint notes
content:
Shift: 22:00-06:00 (UTC)
Date: 2028-08-03 -> 2028-08-04
Persona: night bridge, rotating

Quick context / mood: tired but stable cluster. Two low-priority pagers early, one persistent tail-page for model coldstarts (flapping). Mostly triage and followup notes; need a few runbook edits.

Timeline + pages (rough)
- 22:12 Pager: svc-hosting-high-latency (alerts spike on p50->p95 in us-west-2).
  - Actions: validated with grafana dashboard, spike corresponded to a single model deployment rollout. Rolled traffic back to previous revision using canary flag.
  - Command snippets I ran:
    - kubectl -n hosting rollout undo deploy/model-router --to-revision=3
    - curl -v --header 'x-redwood-model: gpt-lite-v2' https://canary.example/api/health
  - Notes: need a guard in deployment pipeline to block canary if p95 > 200ms for more than 2 minutes. File a follow-up.

- 00:40 Recurrent pager: kv-cache-hit-rate drop (embedding-cache-node-3).
  - Observed: node 3 was showing repeated OOM kills in dmesg around 00:25-00:35; container restarted by kubelet. Pod back up but cache priming lag persisted.
  - Quick fix: cordon node3, drain, and restart the cache pod on node1+2 for rebalancing.
    - kubectl cordon node3
    - kubectl drain node3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
  - Follow-up: investigate why OOM thresholds didn't trigger earlier autoscaler behavior. Suspect memory limits misaligned with quantized model memory profile.-> Action: add ticket to test quantized-worker memory envelopes.

- 03:10 Ongoing: coldstart latency regressions for small-chat (repro steps below). Reported by a small internal experiment run.
  - Repro: send 50 concurrent warm requests vs 50 cold (new session) requests. Cold requests p95 spikes > 1.2s (expected ~350ms).
  - Tracing: KV cache miss ratio jumps at new session; serving runtime kernel selection delayed by repeated fallback to FP16 path. Race seen when model variant not loaded.
  - Temp mitigation: increase prefetch concurrency for small-chat on us-west-2 until release of proper fix. Set prefetchCount=4 for small-chat profile in routing table.
  - TODO: add a startup prewarm hook in rollout job to populate KV cache for top-10 prefix sets. See runbook TODOs below.

Incident follow-ups (assignments)
- OPS-1427 (deployment guard for canaries) -> assigned to @Noah, due EOD+3. Suggested acceptance criteria: blocked canary when p95 > 200ms for 2m; automatic rollback with tags and slack alert to #sre-bridge. Linked: JIRA-OPS-1427.
- INF-2319 (quantized-worker memory envelope testing) -> assigned to @Mina. Add two capacity tests: low-latency (1s window) and sustained (30m). Include histograms.
- RUNBOOK-EDIT-09 (prewarm hook for small-chat) -> assign to me (Sylvie). Add steps + exact CURL-based priming script and highlight cost estimate.

Runbook TODOs / edits (short notes for subsequent PR)
- deployment/canary-checks.md: add explicit metric check step with threshold, a script to fetch p95 from metrics API, and a fail-open vs fail-closed decision tree.
- runtime/kv-cache.md: add troubleshooting section for OOM vs eviction patterns; include how to check dmesg and container logs quickly and recommended memory settings for quantized models.
- routing/prefetch.md: document prefetchCount, heuristics for small vs large models, and a short script to toggle prefetch for a given route via admin API.

Commands & quick snippets I used (copyable)
- Check recent rollouts: kubectl -n hosting rollout status deploy/model-router --watch
- Recreate cache pod on node1: kubectl delete pod cache-embedding-0-abcde -n inference && kubectl get pods -n inference -w
- Pull p95 metric: curl -s 'https://metrics.internal/api/query?p95&service=small-chat&window=2m' | jq '.value'

Questions for next-day pair (Mina / Noah)
- Mina: can you reproduce the OOM on a dev node with the same quantized model variant? If yes, collect /proc/meminfo and container cgroups data during the spike and upload to /tmp/oom-records/
- Noah: implement the simplest canary guard script and wire it to the existing rollout pipeline. Keep it togglable and add a rollback label when triggered.

Loose observations / ideas (brain dump)
- Prefetch as a per-route feature might be expensive but cheaper than repeated coldstart p95 spikes for PLG customers. Add cost estimate to the prewarm runbook.
- Explore adding a small persistent in-memory top-prefix cache on the router layer to reduce early request KV cache misses for small-chat. Could be bounded to 10MB per router.

Personal to-dos (me)
- Draft RUNBOOK-EDIT-09 (prewarm script + cost note) — 1.5h (tomorrow morning)
- Open PR for deployment guard (skeleton) and drop into ops-review — 30m
- Collect traces from 03:10 small-chat job and attach to INF ticket — 45m

Attachments / links I dropped during shift:
- Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/serving/latency-overview?orgId=1&var-region=us-west-2
- Traces: https://jaeger.internal/trace/abc123-small-chat-20280803
- Dev note: github.com/redwood/inference/issues/inf-2319

End of notes.

(If you pick this up: quick sync 09:30 UTC — I'll be online to hand over context. If urgent, ping #sre-bridge with tag @Sylvie.)
